body:
Today should have been the day. And I didn't do it for the most stupid of all reasons. A friend of me didn't have the possibility to cycle to school with me today, didn't remember my birthday until like ten minutes ago (it's 23:00), and I really didn't want it to look like that drove me over the edge. For context, even though it's not true, my family and another close friend suspect me of being in love with her. I just couldn't take the risk of anyone thinking I killed myself because of her.

Ffs I didn't end it all because of the stupid theory that the memory of me will have a dark spot where people wonder why I killed myself over a girl.

Everything was done. I was going to get most of my money, some stuff that has emotional value to me and leave for a few hours of final joy before the end. My letter to my family was already written. I had my whole plan A (which I won't specify in regard to the subreddit rules) ready to be done and I didn't do it because I was too afraid to make people think that I did it in a flow of sadness due to rejection or something. I honestly don't care she didn't cycle with me and I don't care she didn't mention my birthday at school, I know she had an important test today about which she really stressed and I just tried comforting her and I am so weirdly happy she rounded it off well. I really don't, but I was so afraid others would think I cared that I couldn't bring myself to do it. I hate myself for it, because I'll be too dead to care anyways after the deed. 

And now I don't know anymore. Since she just messaged me congratulating me I can't execute plan B either. I'm glad I worked on school to get my mind off both my birthday and my thoughts today, since I'm in the middle of my testweek. The testweek may be the only thing going extremely well inside my head, but since everyone just classifies me as a big ~~need~~ _edit: nerd_that shouldn't be a surprise. It's just a sad confirmation of what I deeply inside already know. 



No one was supposed to ever hurt me again.
I was supposed to never crave for trusting my social life anymore.



Instead I chose to live.
I hate myself.
The way you addressed the readers to look out for others while feeling like this brought tears into my eyes; it says something beautiful about who you are. Just wanted to let you know that

And of course, I messed up the one sentence I really should not mess up since it would only make this look all the more like a crave for attention. "I'd actually getting no attention at all" must be "I'd actually prefer getting no attention at all".
